items.title: Qwen3.8-27B super-adapter merges all harness LoRAs into one, with SWE-Bench Pro gains under two harnesses
items.summary: A single larger LoRA made by concatenating the week's per-harness adapters for Qwen3.8-27B. The author reports SWE-Bench Pro (Hard 51) rising from 45% to 61% under Hermes Agent and 47% to 67% under OpenCode, flat at 74% under pi, and 19-48% fewer tool calls with thinking on.

items.title: OVH releases Olala Mini 7A1B, a small MoE that activates about 1B parameters per request and runs agentic tasks without a GPU
items.summary: OVHcloud's Olala v1.0 mini (7B total, about 1B active, 32K context) is published on Hugging Face with a hosted playground; the post cites 220-380 tokens/s on B300 GPUs. A 128K v1.1 is promised but not shipped.

items.title: Diffusers gains a LoRA fine-tuning example for NVIDIA's RFD4-Proteina protein-design model
items.summary: A Diffusers pull request adds a rank-32 LoRA training example on the denoiser of RFD4-Proteina, using flow-matching losses on backbone coordinates and local latents, so protein-design models can be adapted with the same code path as image and video models.

items.title: Paper 'LM Harnesses are Compositional Generalizers' reports a harnessed 27B model at 58.5 average vs 30.5 for the base
items.summary: The authors argue that harness abstractions let a language model generalize over longer tasks and deeper recursion by keeping training trajectories locally in-distribution. A reply cites Table 4 (RLM-27B 58.5 average vs 30.5 base); the post's paper link points to alphaxiv with a non-standard id and no code is linked.

doubt.pushback: Paper link has a non-standard id and no code or weights are linked, so the numbers cannot be checked yet.

reception.summary: Replies mostly restate the framing or pitch unrelated team-process takes; one asks whether the simulated tool calls include failures, and nobody reports reproducing it.

items.title: TensorFold 1.3.0 adds 'tensorfold models' to list chat models that fit your machine before you download
items.summary: The new command lists chat models that fit the local machine, largest first, with the memory each needs, a quality score and a rough speed, so large pulls can be avoided.

items.title: PaperReview: open-source Apple Silicon app that transcribes handwritten English essays with MiniCPM-OCR and links edits to the original page
items.summary: A local macOS app that reads photographed handwritten essays with MiniCPM-OCR 1.0, uses MiniCPM-OCR Jev to check how well candidate words match the photo, and lets a teacher accept or dismiss each suggestion.

items.title: Claude Code hooks can now fail closed with onFailure: block (command and http hooks since 2.1.295, mcp_tool since 2.1.328)
items.summary: By default a hook that errors, times out or cannot reach its MCP server lets the tool call run anyway. Adding onFailure set to block makes a failed hook block the call; the author describes a check with a missing PreToolUse script that blocks ls.

security_na.reason: Claude Code hook hardening tip (config option), not a vulnerability or compromised release; no stack action.
